description: A high-level, general-purpose programming language widely used in data science, machine learning, web development, and automation.
The core language of the World Wide Web, essential for client-side and server-side (Node.js) interactive web applications.
A robust, class-based, object-oriented programming language designed for portability and widely used in enterprise-scale backend systems and Android apps.
A strict syntactical superset of JavaScript that adds optional static typing to improve code quality and maintainability.
An extension of the C language providing high performance, used extensively in system/software development, game engines, and high-frequency trading.
A modern, object-oriented programming language developed by Microsoft, prominent in Windows desktop apps, enterprise software, and game development (Unity).
A popular general-purpose scripting language that is especially suited to web development and powers platforms like WordPress.
A foundational procedural programming language for system programming, embedded systems, and operating systems development.
An open-source programming language developed by Google, prized for its simplicity, concurrency support, and efficiency in cloud-native microservices.
A domain-specific language designed for managing and querying data held in relational database management systems.
